methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected for each provider on the accessed date; the providers' own pricing pages render prices client-side, so each plan's official pricing page is recorded as source while the exact USD figures were corroborated against a dedicated 2026 pricing-review source recorded as corroboration. All prices are flat per-account per month in USD, with both annual-billing monthly rate and month-to-month rate noted where published and annualDiscountPct recorded where derivable. Quote-only Enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd null; minutes/calls/overage and HIPAA/BAA do not apply to website builders and are null.

vendors.name: Webflow
vendors.provenance: https://webflow.com/pricing (official pricing page, read 2026-09-11 in a browser with the billing switch worked both ways; the switch is a checkbox with its input hidden, which is why earlier plain fetches only ever saw the yearly side). Earlier readings of this vendor leaned on third-party pricing guides because the page renders prices client-side, and those guides described a plan lineup webflow no longer sells: CMS and Business are retired, Premium and Team are new.

plans.name: Starter (Free)
plans.notes: 2 static pages, limited Webflow CMS, 1 GB bandwidth, 50 form submissions, Webflow AI, MCP server, Webflow Cloud app hosting; published on a webflow.io subdomain only.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate $15/mo (40% annual discount); $25/mo month-to-month. Custom domain, 300 static pages, 10 GB bandwidth, unlimited form submissions, password protection, Webflow AI, MCP server; no CMS.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate $25/mo (~36% annual discount); $39/mo month-to-month. Everything in Basic plus Webflow CMS, code components, site search, form file upload. Figure is the 50 GB bandwidth tier; the card sells tiers up to 2.5 TB at higher prices.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Annual contract required; no month-to-month option. $2,500/mo = annualized monthly rate. Everything in Premium plus Workspace-level controls, Webflow Localize, AEO agents, publishing workflows, single-page publishing, site activity log and API, enhanced security and compliance, priority support.

plans.name: Ecommerce Standard
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate $29/mo (~31% annual discount); $42/mo month-to-month. Bought on top of a site plan. 500 ecommerce items, 2% transaction fee, custom shopping cart and checkout.

plans.name: Ecommerce Plus

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: Weebly
vendors.provenance: https://www.weebly.com/pricing, re-read 2026-09-10. THIS RECORD WAS REBUILT THAT DAY. It previously carried USD prices that are not on the page: the provenance itself said they were "corroborated via WebsitePlanet and Tooltester" reviews, and a 2026-09-03 re-verification recorded Personal $10 -> $13, Professional $12 -> $15 and Performance $26 -> $32 as vendor price moves. They were neither vendor moves nor first-party figures, and the plan notes contradicted themselves: Personal read "annual-billing rate $13; $13/mo month-to-month", and Performance claimed an annual rate of $32 against $29 month-to-month, which no discount can produce. The page renders prices client-side in one currency per visitor and served euros to every read: Personal €11/mo billed annually or €14 month-to-month, Professional €17 or €22, Performance €30 or €40, Free at no charge. No USD price is recorded for any paid tier, as it is for any vendor whose published price this schema's money fields cannot carry.

The pricing page serves one currency per visitor and named no USD anywhere in the document, so every USD price here is left unrecorded rather than converted. 500 MB storage, unlimited bandwidth, custom domain support, digital goods sales, shipping calculations.

Unlimited storage and bandwidth, password-protected pages, video backgrounds, up to 100 site members, ad-free, free domain for first year.

plans.name: Performance
